gaps_and_limitations: This is not an exhaustive scan of public X in the window.
Grok X Search tools expose no enable_image_understanding parameter; posters were downloaded separately when media URLs were present.
X Search often truncated trailing apply lines and t.co links (Prime Intellect 'Apply here:', DeepGrove 'we'd love to chat:', AUDER 既存求人一覧).
DeepSeek QR codes were visible but not decoded to a public URL; email remains the recovered route.
The Nous investor apply image did not download as the hiring poster.
Latest-mode ranking is biased toward the end of the window; quieter mid-window posts can be missed.
Official handle searches were not run for every repository-tracked brand. MiniMax, Qwen, Moonshot, GLM, StepFun, and others produced no concrete official listings in the ZH org-centric pass.
Japanese bare 採用/求人 queries are dominated by recruiting commentary and technology-adoption news.
Many recruiter posts omit the employer and were excluded.
Some early org-centric calls in this continuation omitted since/until; kept posts were still timestamp-checked against the window.
HTTP recovery of https://www.primeintellect.ai/careers -> Ashby is outside X Search text and is documented as such.
